title: Boker Tov - Shavua Tov Monday night Parsha class
memo:
Boker Tov - Shavua Tov 

Monday night Parsha class is ON tonight for a special Rosh Hashanah edition! 🍎🍯

*The Torah Readings of Rosh Hashanah and how they help us stand before Hashem in the new year* 

We will recount the story of Sarah Imenu being remembered for a child, and then follow Yitzchak to the Akeda... 

What are the lessons that continue to today? What is the secret to Rosh Hashanah? Why do we read these stories on Rosh Hashanah?
